body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> Delphi presented ''SKYfi3'' boom box during CES 2007. It is compatible with XM satellite receivers as well as iPod.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
